data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue for Patriot
data.body:
Hi,

Patriot Financial Partners GP II, L.P.'s most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in USCB, AVBH, and NEWT.

On September 14, 2026, NEWT filed an earnings release (8-K Item 2.02, Exhibit 99.1). (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1587987/000162828026061720/a3q2026dividendannouncem.htm)

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Best,
Andrew
